title: notholaena jaliscana
intro: Notholaena jaliscana, commonly known as the Jalisco fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Notholaena jaliscana include pain relief, wound healing, and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
